{"task": {"id": "I_kwDOVQjdzc8AAAABYlHPZQ", "item_id": "PVTI_lAHOAHSLSM4Bn3IVzhCKBk8", "project_id": "PVT_kwHOAHSLSM4Bn3IV", "number": 17, "title": "Continue remaining Saturn hardware implementation and automated acceptance (after #15)", "body": "## Administrative continuation of #15

This is the active continuation tracker for the unmet hardware scope of #15. The Run's finalization instruction requires closing #15 after merged PR #16; that administrative closure is **not hardware completion**. Do not reopen #11, #13 or #15. References identifying #15 as the active tracker in the current repository documentation are historical after this handoff; subsequent implementation should update them to this continuation.

PR #16 (https://github.com/takahirox/saturn-rust/pull/16), merged as `dbd981b030a46daa6923072ce240680dd2e58ebf`, implements SH-2 address-error dispatch, independent semantic tests and an original MIT-licensed synthetic BIOS fixture executed in native and browser Wasm tests. Preserve this work, Star Collector, backup RAM and both direct digital pads. No umbrella acceptance checkbox is satisfied by that checkpoint alone.

Remaining work includes full SH-2/SH7604 semantics and peripherals, slave SH-2, MC68EC000, complete bus/cache/reset/backup services and hardware-time scheduling, SCU/DMA/DSP, VDP1/advanced VDP2, SCSP/DSP/CD-DA/WebAudio, runtime CD/BIN/CUE/BIOS/HLE services, full SMPC/analog input, both required new guest demos and comprehensive native/Wasm integration evidence. Current evidence: [conformance matrix](https://github.com/takahirox/saturn-rust/blob/dbd981b030a46daa6923072ce240680dd2e58ebf/docs/hardware-conformance.md) and [validation record](https://github.com/takahirox/saturn-rust/blob/dbd981b030a46daa6923072ce240680dd2e58ebf/docs/validation-issue-15.md).

The full original requirements and unchecked acceptance criteria are preserved below. Baseline statements referring to revision `1327d81` describe the pre-PR #16 state; use the progress above and current conformance matrix when selecting the next pending hardware implementation. Continue autonomously with original licensed fixtures and local/CI native, Wasm and browser checks. No personal firmware, human testing/approval, live Pages inspection or external workflow investigation is required. Partial PRs must describe their scope accurately, reference this continuation without closing keywords, and leave its unmet criteria open.

---

## Original #15 requirements (preserved)

## Problem

The previous comprehensive hardware trackers, #11 and #13, were administratively closed after **partial** PRs #12 and #14 were merged. Their acceptance criteria were not met. The [current conformance matrix](https://github.com/takahirox/saturn-rust/blob/main/docs/hardware-conformance.md) and [validation for #13](https://github.com/takahirox/saturn-rust/blob/main/docs/validation-issue-13.md) explicitly document the missing components.

**Create one new, comprehensive implementation task whose completion means implementing and automatically verifying the outstanding Sega Saturn hardware.** This task must be executable by autonomous AI development: **no required human testing, owner approval, physical console, externally supplied firmware, workflow-administrator confirmation, subjective visual sign-off, or other human-only gate**.

This Issue replaces the **uncompleted hardware scope** of #11/#13; it does **not** reopen either closed Issue. Previous partial SH-2, Star Collector, backup-RAM and second-pad work remains valid and must be preserved.

## Expected outcome

A from-scratch Rust **functional baseline of the standard built-in Sega Saturn** that runs native automated tests and compiles to WebAssembly for the existing GitHub Pages Play/Debug app. Both CPUs and major chips must function as guest-visible emulated hardware, not placeholder MMIO or per-game hooks. Provide reproducible, legally redistributable homebrew/diagnostic discs that exercise the system end-to-end.

"Functional baseline" requires documented software-visible programming behavior of **all listed built-in systems**, not analog-perfect circuitry, guaranteed 100% commercial-game compatibility or a particular FPS. Keep known deviations explicit and tested. Each completion checkbox below requires executable, objective evidence.

### Autonomous execution and review policy — mandatory

- **Do not stop progress to ask for human testing, personal approval, proprietary BIOS files, copyrighted games, GitWeave configuration confirmation, or verification of how automatic Issue closure works.** Those are **not** acceptance criteria. The project should use its existing AI implementation/review/test workflow and continue automatically when technical tests allow.
- **Do not make a live GitHub Pages manual check a pre-merge condition.** All pre-merge requirements must run in a local/CI native+Wasm+headless browser context. Production publication can be checked automatically after merge, if a workflow supports that, but must not hold PR approval/merge.
- **Do not block a hardware PR on GitWeave's separate auto-close behavior**. A PR that completes only part of this Issue may merge with an accurate "partial" description. Avoid closing keywords in partial PRs. If external automation nevertheless closes this umbrella Issue on a partial merge, treat the state as administrative, not proof of completion; continue the unmet tasks through a newly created continuation Issue if necessary, without human intervention. Investigation or owner confirmation of the external workflow is not required here.
- Independent/manual-derived implementation and automated validation are mandatory. Avoid silently declaring success, manufacturing test results, ignoring unimplemented registers, or substituting host code for guest computation.
- **No hard human-approval/dependency gate** for selecting and licensing a demo: choose wholly original game code/art/audio and explicitly license those files (e.g., MIT) when third-party redistribution cannot be documented. Never include proprietary BIOSes, Sega SDK objects, commercial disc data, or unauthorized assets.

## Context and reproduction

New functionality; reproduction steps are not applicable.

At the checked main revision **`1327d81dfd1a011b69990fd26abf4cefd04a9a52`**:

- `src/cpu.rs`, `src/cpu/tests.rs`: master SH-2 interpreter handles 142 decoded instruction forms with selected semantic/exception/interrupt tests, but lacks integrated second CPU, SH7604 cache/on-chip devices and architectural address-error dispatch.
- `src/lib.rs`, `src/bus.rs`: partial bus and instruction-budget frame runner; no synchronized hardware-time scheduler or complete retail memory map.
- `src/devices.rs`: limited VDP2 bitmap and SMPC direct digital input for both ports; no VDP1, full SMPC, SCU or sound.
- `src/disc.rs`: constrained Saturn IP/ISO9660 HLE first-read disc loader; no runtime CD block, BIN/CUE mixed tracks or general BIOS services.
- Raw 32 KiB backup RAM, explicit local import/export and second pad have been added by PR #14, but the full backup-memory register/software contract remains incomplete.
- `homebrew/star-collector` and `web/`: the original licensed playable game and polished Play/Debug Wasm application must continue to pass tests.

Follow [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/takahirox/saturn-rust/blob/main/AGENTS.md), [Issue template](https://github.com/takahirox/saturn-rust/blob/main/.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/issue.md), [development flow](https://github.com/takahirox/saturn-rust/blob/main/docs/development-flow.md), [review guidelines](https://github.com/takahirox/saturn-rust/blob/main/docs/review-guidelines.md), and [architecture](https://github.com/takahirox/saturn-rust/blob/main/docs/architecture.md). Keep new Issue/PR text, commits and implementation documentation in English. Recheck upstream main before working.

Use [original Hitachi, Motorola and Sega manuals](https://github.com/luckyseoul/saturn-docs) as the behavioral reference: SH-1/SH-2 and SH7604 manuals, M68000 programmer's manual, Saturn Overview, SCU/SCU DSP, VDP1, VDP2, SMPC, SCSP/SCSP DSP, CD Block, Disc Format and Boot ROM/System Program manuals. Cite section/table numbers in tests or the conformance matrix. **No third-party CPU/emulator/device core, copied emulator source or transliterated proprietary SDK routines.** Infrastructure packages for Wasm, browser audio, testing and guest builds are permitted under their licenses.

## Outstanding implementation requirements

### 1. SH-2 and MC68EC000 CPU architecture

- Finish SH-2 architectural semantics beyond decode coverage: address-error exception entry, faulting PC/stack/state, slot-illegal behavior and deferral, interrupt priorities and acknowledgements, privileged/exception edge cases, sleep/wake, flags, delay slots and memory width/endian behavior for every documented instruction form. Add comprehensive semantic vector tests, not just all-65,536 encoding classification.
- Independently implement and execute the **slave SH-2** with correct independent reset/start/stop, shared bus, inter-CPU communication and IRQ; emulate SH7604 cache/coherency and P1/P2/P4 accesses, mapped FRT, WDT, SCI, on-chip DMAC, DIVU, INTC, BSC, UBC/standby and other built-in software-visible registers.
- Independently implement the **MC68EC000 sound CPU**, including all applicable MC68000 instruction families and effective-address modes, CCR/SR, user/supervisor stacks, exceptions, interrupt levels, reset and real sound RAM/SCSP bus access. Exclude instructions introduced only in later 68k models.

### 2. Full base memory, reset and synchronized execution

- Map standard-console BIOS, low/high RAM and mirrors, cache regions, sound RAM, SCU, SMPC, CD block, VDP1 VRAM/framebuffers, VDP2 VRAM/CRAM/MMIO and backup RAM with documented access widths, bus-lane semantics, alignment/exception behavior and software-visible unmapped/open-bus handling.
- Complete backup RAM odd/even bus accesses and filesystem/service integration on top of the existing exact-size raw import/export, retaining bytes across appropriate power/reset domains; test invalid import atomicity and reset independence.
- Introduce a deterministic **hardware-time event scheduler**, replacing mere instruction-counted frames, to coordinate both SH-2s, 68k, HBlank/VBlank/scanlines, interrupts, on-chip timers, bus access, DMA, CD activity and audio production. Assert event ordering, reset, contention and cross-clock communication in guest tests. Maintain bounded execution so browser UI stays responsive.

### 3. SCU / DMA / SCU DSP

- Implement SCU MMIO, interrupt masks/priorities/acknowledgement, all supported DMA channels, direct/indirect transfer modes, trigger sources, increments, end/error behavior and arbitration with CPU/VRAM/sound/CD.
- Implement the actual **SCU DSP interpreter**, its registers, instruction semantics, internal memory and data transfers, control/status/interrupts. Run independently authored DSP programs; accepting register writes or ignoring DSP commands is not completion.

### 4. VDP1 and complete standard VDP2 programming model

- VDP1 command control flow, clipping/local coordinates, normal/scaled/distorted sprites, polygons/lines/polylines, framebuffer draw/erase/swap, textures/color/palette modes, Gouraud shading, transparency/shadow/half-luminance, status and interrupts.
- VDP2 NBG0–NBG3, rotation backgrounds, tile/bitmap and CRAM formats, VRAM banking/cycle patterns, scrolling/zoom, line and window effects, mosaic, priorities, color calculation/blending/offset/shadow, supported display modes/interlace/resolutions, blanking and video timing.
- Compose VDP1 and VDP2 from emulated VRAM/registers with deterministic pixel-level tests for sprite/background overlap, priority, blending, rotation and window behavior. Do not use game-specific host rendering.

### 5. Sound CPU, SCSP and browser audio

- Integrate the MC68EC000 with SCSP sound RAM/MMIO, **32 voices** and supported PCM/FM-related behavior, sample looping, envelope, pitch, LFO, modulation, pan/mix, timers, DMA, MIDI and interrupts.
- Implement and test an **executing SCSP effects DSP** with its program and signal-routing registers. Add native tests comparing deterministic generated stereo sample buffers with known expected samples/tolerances.
- Provide browser audio playback using a bounded producer/consumer pipeline (e.g., AudioWorklet); validate via automated WebAudio capture or deterministic buffer instrumentation without requiring a human to listen. User-gesture blocking/muting/underflow must be observable, not treated as successful audible playback.
- Include CD-DA track playback/mixing through the host-visible CD/SCSP route.

### 6. CD block, BIOS and discs

- Implement runtime CD-block host-visible command/status/HIRQ, reads/transfers, TOC/sector/track state, seekers/filters/selectors/partitions, audio commands and their software-visible timing. Do not substitute only pre-boot ISO extraction.
- Support **cooked ISO and BIN/CUE** including 2352-byte sectors, track indices/pregaps, multiple data/audio tracks and malformed/missing files; provide parser/bounds/error and guest runtime-read tests. CHD/compression is optional.
- Keep two separate startup modes: (a) **externally supplied genuine BIOS** fetched only from the user's own local file, with correct reset/MMIO behavior; (b) **BIOS-free independent HLE** providing documented bootstrap and system/backup/CD services with ABI and side-effect tests. Do not silently substitute HLE when BIOS is selected.
- **Crucially, do not require any human to supply or test a Sega BIOS to close this Issue**. Use an **original synthetic BIOS/boot ROM fixture** exercising reset initialization, MMIO/interrupt/service pathways in native and Wasm tests. Genuine commercial BIOS boot/menu and retail compatibility are optional extra validation only; if no lawful firmware is available, state "not independently confirmed" rather than claiming it worked. Do not download or package third-party firmware.

### 7. SMPC and controllers

- Implement command sequencing, command latency/status, INTBACK, RTC with deterministic emulated time, region flags, reset/clock/power and slave/sound CPU controls, interrupts and both controller ports.
- Preserve two independent digital pads; add standard analog-pad reports, guest-visible button/axis/timing semantics. Browser keyboard/gamepad mapping can be tested with synthetic Gamepad API inputs; never write guest game state directly from JS.
- Keep existing focus-loss/input-release, Play/Debug, and local-file safety behavior.

### 8. Licensed demonstrations and meaningful independent integration

Beyond original **Star Collector**, include reproducible, original, permissively licensed Saturn-targeted *guest programs* as CI/test media:

1. **Playable VDP1+VDP2+SCSP homebrew**: guest SH-2 logic and SMPC input, independently rendered sprite/polygon and background composition, guest-driven nonzero stereo sound, progress/win-loss/restart behavior.
2. **Hardware exerciser disc**: guest code exercising master/slave SH-2 synchronization, SCU DMA+interrupts+executing DSP, 68k+SCSP DSP, CD runtime sector reads and CD-DA, advanced VDP2, backup and SMPC commands. Multiple menu-driven scenes or deterministic diagnostic routines are acceptable.

Supply original source, original/no-risk assets, build scripts, license text for each new demo and generated discs, provenance and reproducible hashes. Never make discovery or redistribution approval of Disasteroids, Noiz2sa or other third-party media a blocker: **original self-authored demos are the default safe path**. Third-party games may be listed as reference/optional user-loaded compatibility targets after a documented audit, not bundled automatically.

All demonstrations must execute as guest SH-2/68k/DSP instructions and real device MMIO. Tests must reject host-drawn gameplay, special-case game detection, no-op CPU/device implementations and canned frame/audio output.

## Automated coverage and closure evidence

Expand [docs/hardware-conformance.md](https://github.com/takahirox/saturn-rust/blob/main/docs/hardware-conformance.md) into a traceable inventory of **all required** architectural opcode families, device register groups, interrupts, DMA modes, video modes and audio functions. For each entry, link primary specification, implementation module/function, native test, Wasm/browser or guest-integration test and unsupported deviations. A dummy register whose read/write is accepted with no correct effect is **not implemented**.

Use source-authored golden register/pixel/audio vectors, guest test ROMs, fuzz/property checks for malformed media and repeatable event traces. These must work automatically without camera capture, physical Saturn hardware, personal files, proprietary BIOS, a subjective reviewer or external account setup.

## Pre-merge acceptance criteria

**This checklist defines completion of the entire umbrella Issue.** Partial PRs may be merged only with accurately reported scope; their merge does not mean this checklist passed. No checkbox may depend on manual/human verification.

- [ ] **CPU cores:** SH-2 semantic and exception/interrupt/SH7604 peripheral tests, independent slave SH-2 execution, and applicable MC68EC000 opcodes/exception semantics pass native tests and genuine guest-program integration.
- [ ] **Bus/scheduler/reset/backup:** full built-in memory mapping, caching/coherence and bus-lane/exception behavior, deterministic multiprocessor/hardware-time ordering, reset domains and persistent backup services pass repeatable tests.
- [ ] **SCU:** DMA channels/modes, interrupts/arbitration and executing SCU DSP pass independent register/guest/DSP-program tests.
- [ ] **Video:** VDP1 and standard VDP2 modes, effects, interrupts and composition pass reference pixel/framebuffer tests from guest VRAM/register writes (including rotation/window/priority/blending).
- [ ] **Audio:** 68k-controlled SCSP synthesis, interrupts, effects DSP and mixed CD-DA produce reproducible non-silent stereo samples, with automated browser WebAudio-path tests (no human listening required).
- [ ] **CD/media:** runtime CD commands/HIRQ/sector transfers, ISO and BIN/CUE mixed tracks, failure handling, and BIOS/HLE services pass independent guest, parser and browser tests.
- [ ] **BIOS:** the external-BIOS path and separate BIOS-less HLE have testable, correct behavior against **original synthetic BIOS + HLE call fixtures**. **A proprietary real-BIOS file, visual BIOS-menu test or human sign-off is NOT required** and lack of one must not block completion.
- [ ] **SMPC/input:** commands/INTBACK/RTC/system controls, both digital ports and analog input pass guest-visible timing/control tests and automated browser input/focus/privacy checks.
- [ ] **Demos:** Star Collector still completes/restarts; both newly authored, fully license-cleared reproducible Saturn disc demonstrations run in actual native and browser Wasm guest execution with automated assertions for graphics, non-silent audio, control, dual CPU, CD/DMA/IRQ/DSP and restart/result states.
- [ ] **Coverage evidence:** all mandatory features in the conformance matrix have a linked implementation and passing native and relevant Wasm/guest tests; no missing built-in subsystem, undocumented game-specific bypass or silently ignored hardware commands.
- [ ] **CI and distribution:** `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo build --locked`, `cargo test --locked`, native/Wasm Clippy, `sh scripts/build-web.sh`, reproducible guest-media builds, and existing extended `npm run test:browser` pass without skipping required tests; Pages project-subpath asset packaging/privacy remain intact. Do not require live-site inspection before merge.
- [ ] **Autonomous flow:** technical review relies on the reproducible checks above. No manual device tests, human confirmation, legal approval, external workflow-owner decision, or GitWeave close-on-merge investigation is an acceptance condition. Continue to next pending hardware implementation without waiting for such input.

## Optional validation

Run lawful, user-supplied real BIOS and commercial disc compatibility tests **only if the tester already has them**; compare reference emulator or original-console results if independently available; explore more licensed third-party demos, Safari/Firefox, CHD and optional accessories. Such work must **never delay or block completion of this Issue**. No undocumented claims of compatibility without evidence.

CPU optimizations (Web Workers, dynarec/JIT, SIMD), performance targets, physical controllers and special accessories can be separate subsequent Issues. They are not correctness gates here.

## Required post-merge verification

**None that requires a human.** Any GitHub Pages smoke verification can run automatically against the deployed URL and report results or create a follow-up Issue; it is not a required approval/closure gate. The mandatory **pre-merge** Wasm/Playwright suite already verifies the browser player and hardware demos using the same built static assets under `/saturn-rust/`.

**Do not reopen #11 or #13. This new Issue is the current umbrella backlog until the implementation/test checklist above is satisfied, regardless of an external workflow's administrative closed/open state.**
